The kit mixer, round 2

The screens round 1 did not cover. Choose a look for each piece and the phone updates as you go. A dot (●) marks pieces on the screen you're viewing. Hover over a row, or tap a piece on the phone, to find it. Add a note under any piece; notes go out with Copy picks. Round-1 style applies what your round-1 picks imply: vellum for node panels and their buttons, brass for menu-like screens, close buttons and SKIP. The shop's cards stay plain in every look. Picks and notes save on this device and in the link. Everything here is mock data.
